'''Jeordwyn Semaris den Tropan''' is one of the [[Council of Nine]] in [[Illian]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a narrow jaw.

== Activities ==
He is led by [[Davram Bashere]] into battle against the [[Seanchan]] just outside [[Ebou Dar]].
